question: What does the abbreviation ASCII stand for?

options.text: Automated System Code for International Interfacing
American Standard Code for Information Interchange
Advanced Standard Communication for Information Integration
American Standard Code for Internet Information

solution:
The correct answer is __**American Standard Code for Information Interchange**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **ASCII** stands for American Standard Code for Information Interchange, a character encoding standard developed in the 1960s.
 
• It is primarily used to represent text in computers, telecommunications equipment, and other devices.
 
• ASCII uses **7-bit binary numbers**
